#### 1. Kilocode Shift-click to open chat links in system browser SMALL ~2-3h (tools, TUI)

- **What**: Kilocode PR #14919 (merged 2026-10-08) adds Shift-click to open chat links in system browser instead of VSCode simple browser. Commit title: "feat(vscode): open chat links in system browser on Shift-click". Users Shift-click a link in chat transcript to open it in their default system browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari) rather than VSCode's embedded webview. Alexi TUI displays links in transcript markdown rendering but has no click/keybind to open them. TUI could add Shift+number keybind (e.g. Shift+1 opens first URL in visible transcript) or prompt for URL selection when multiple links present.

- **Why**: Alexi TUI uses marked + marked-terminal to render markdown transcript in `src/cli/tui/components/Chat.tsx` (or similar transcript component). Links are displayed but not interactive (terminal limitation). Kilocode pattern: detect Shift modifier + click event, extract URL from clicked element, call `open` module or `xdg-open`/`start` to launch system browser. Alexi TUI equivalent: (1) parse visible transcript for URLs (regex `https?://[^\s]+` or marked AST traversal for link nodes), (2) register Shift+number keybind in `src/cli/tui/context/KeybindContext.tsx` (e.g. Shift+1 through Shift+9 for first 9 URLs), (3) implement handler that extracts Nth URL from transcript state, (4) call Node.js `open` package (already used in `src/core/open.ts` L19) to launch browser. SMALL ~2-3h: add URL extraction from transcript markdown (marked AST walker or regex on rendered text), register Shift+number keybinds (1-9) in KeybindContext, implement handler that maps number to URL index + calls `open`, add visual feedback (e.g. "(1)" prefix before each URL in transcript), test keybind opens correct URL.

- **Source**: https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14919 (Shift-click browser open), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/core/open.ts L19 (open package usage), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/cli/tui/context/KeybindContext.tsx (keybind registry)

#### 2. Kilocode embedding dimension retry for OpenAI-compatible endpoints MEDIUM ~4-6h (provider, embeddings)

- **What**: Kilocode PR #14921 (merged 2026-10-08) adds dimension parameter retry for OpenAI-compatible embedding endpoints. Commit titles: "fix(indexing): tolerate OpenAI-compatible endpoints that reject dimensions", "fix(indexing): cache dimension omission only after usable fallback", "fix(indexing): surface endpoint error envelope during validation", "fix(indexing): guard response shape before decoding embeddings", "refactor(indexing): project embedding response once per request". OpenAI-compatible servers (e.g. LM Studio, Ollama with OpenAI adapter, vLLM) may reject the optional `dimensions` parameter with HTTP 400/422. Kilocode now keeps configured vector size, retries without `dimensions` once, accepts fallback only when returned vectors match configured size, caches the omission per model after successful retry, reports clear error on size mismatch. Also guards response shape (decode only when `data` array present, preserve server error message from 200 responses without data).

- **Why**: Alexi has codesearch tool (`src/tool/tools/codesearch.ts`) using embeddings (check implementation for embedding provider calls). Providers in `src/providers/` (SAP AI Core, OpenAI gateway, etc.) send embedding requests with `dimensions` parameter per OpenAI spec. OpenAI-compatible servers (LM Studio, Ollama, vLLM) may not support `dimensions`. Kilocode pattern: (1) send embedding request with `dimensions`, (2) catch 400/422 status, (3) retry same request WITHOUT `dimensions`, (4) verify returned vector length matches expected size, (5) cache `{model: shouldOmitDimensions}` map in memory, (6) use cached omission for subsequent requests. Alexi equivalent: audit embedding request path in `src/providers/openai/` or `src/tool/tools/codesearch.ts`, add retry logic (catch 400/422 on first attempt, retry without `dimensions`, validate vector length), add per-model cache (`Map<string, boolean>` for dimension omission), persist cache to session or config for cross-run reuse. MEDIUM ~4-6h: audit embedding request implementation, add HTTP 400/422 catch + retry without dimensions, implement vector length validation, add in-memory cache + persistence, add unit tests (mock 400 response, verify retry without dimensions, cache hit skips first attempt), verify codesearch still works with dimension-rejecting endpoints.

- **Source**: https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14921 (embedding dimension retry), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/tool/tools/codesearch.ts (embedding usage), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/providers/openai/ (OpenAI provider)

- **Category**: provider (embedding API, OpenAI-compatible)

- **Size**: MEDIUM ~4-6h (audit embedding request path, add 400/422 catch + retry without dimensions, validate vector length, implement per-model cache + persistence, unit tests mock 400 + verify retry + cache, integration test with dimension-rejecting mock server)

#### 3. Cline error detail logging with URL redaction MEDIUM ~6-8h (core, logging, security)

- **What**: Cline PR #14693 (merged 2026-10-08) keeps error details in production logs with URL redaction. Commit titles: "fix(vscode): keep error details in production logs", "fix(vscode): reduce URLs in production log output to their origin", "fix(vscode): redact whole URLs in log text and keep the matcher linear", "fix(vscode): move the URL redaction helper into shared", "refactor(vscode): drop free-text URL scrubbing from the Logger", "fix(vscode): omit JSON parse error messages from production logs", "fix(vscode): keep the entered MCP URL out of the invalid-URL error", "feat(vscode): fingerprint redacted URLs in the browser-open log line". Logger dropped every extra argument unless `IS_DEV` was true, production lost error messages/numbers/booleans. Production now appends `error.message` (with cause chain), numbers, booleans; strings/objects stay dropped (OAuth URLs, terminal contents, settings). URLs in error messages reduced to origin (scheme + host + port), JSON parse errors log only error name (V8/Bun quote parsed input which may contain credentials), MCP invalid-URL error omits entered URL, browser-open logs origin + 3-hex SHA-256 fingerprint. Verbose mode serializes Errors as stacks instead of `{}`, survives circular arguments.

- **Why**: Alexi logger in `src/utils/logger.ts` (71 lines per previous audit) uses `console.log`/`console.error`. Check if extra arguments (error objects, numbers, booleans) are serialized. Cline issue: OAuth URLs with credentials in query/userinfo/path logged in plain text (GitHub OAuth redirect with `code=...`, MCP server URLs with tokens, SAP AI Core URLs with API keys). Alexi equivalent: (1) audit `src/utils/logger.ts` for error detail handling (does `logger.error('message', error)` serialize `error.message` and `error.cause`?), (2) add URL redaction helper (regex `https?://[^\s<>"']+`, extract `new URL(match).origin`, replace full URL with origin in log output), (3) apply redaction to error messages before logging (read `error.message`, apply URL regex + origin extraction, log scrubbed message), (4) add JSON.parse error scrubbing (catch + log only `error.name`, not `error.message` which contains parsed input), (5) add circular reference guard (use `util.inspect` with `depth` limit or custom JSON.stringify replacer). MEDIUM ~6-8h: audit logger error handling, implement URL redaction helper (regex + URL.origin), apply to error messages before log output, add JSON parse error name-only logging, add circular reference guard, unit tests (URL in error message scrubbed, JSON parse error omits input, circular object doesn't crash), audit existing logs for credential leaks.

- **Source**: https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/14693 (error detail logging + URL redaction), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/utils/logger.ts (logger implementation, 71 lines)

- **Category**: tools (logging, security)

- **Size**: MEDIUM ~6-8h (audit logger error handling, implement URL redaction regex + URL.origin extraction, apply to error messages, add JSON parse error name-only logging, add circular reference guard, unit tests URL scrubbing + JSON parse + circular, audit existing logs for leaks)

#### 5. Cline child-stdin EPIPE fix REFERENCE-ONLY (core, hooks, MCP)

- **What**: Cline PR #13762 (merged 2026-10-08) stops child-stdin EPIPE and SAP SDK winston handler from killing host process. Commit title: "fix: child-stdin EPIPE and the SAP SDK's winston handler no longer kill the host process". Two bugs: (1) HookProcess and SDK stdio MCP client wrote to child stdin with no "error" listener; when child dies while write queued, Node fails with EPIPE asynchronously, unhandled raises as uncaught exception, kills host process. Both writers now absorb error and let exit handling report how child ended. (2) `@sap-cloud-sdk/util` (SAP AI Core provider dependency) builds winston logger with `exceptionHandlers` at module load, installs process-wide `uncaughtException` listener that calls `process.exit(1)` 3s later, overriding cline-core's "log but survive" handler. SAP provider now imported lazily inside snapshot-and-diff wrapper, only SAP-registered listeners removed via async context tracking, host listeners with winston names survive. Tests cover hook/MCP server exiting mid-write must fail operation without uncaught exception, importing community module leaves no winston catcher.

- **Why**: Alexi has hooks (`src/hooks/` likely, check for child process spawn), MCP client (`src/mcp/client.ts` 2102 lines, stdio transport writes to server stdin), SAP AI Core provider (`src/providers/sapOrchestration.ts`, depends on `@sap-cloud-sdk/*` or SAP SDK). Audit child stdin writes for error listeners. Cline issue: no error listener on `child.stdin.write()` → EPIPE when child exits → uncaught exception → host exits. SAP SDK winston `uncaughtException` handler → `process.exit(1)` 3s after ANY uncaught exception → host dies even when exception should be caught. Alexi equivalent: (1) audit `src/hooks/` (if exists) for child process spawn + stdin writes, add `child.stdin.on('error', (err) => { /* log + absorb */ })`, (2) audit `src/mcp/client.ts` for stdio transport stdin writes, add error listener, (3) audit `src/providers/sapOrchestration.ts` (or SAP provider import path), check for `@sap-cloud-sdk/util` dependency (`package.json` grep `@sap-cloud-sdk`), test if import registers `uncaughtException` listener (Node.js `process.listeners('uncaughtException')` before/after import), wrap import in async context tracking + listener removal IF winston handler detected. REFERENCE-ONLY: audit first before implementing. MEDIUM ~6-8h IF APPLICABLE after audit confirms issue exists.

- **Source**: https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/13762 (child-stdin EPIPE fix, SAP SDK winston removal), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/mcp/client.ts (MCP client, 2102 lines, stdio transport), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/providers/sapOrchestration.ts (SAP provider), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/hooks/ (hooks, if exists)

- **Category**: N/A (core, reference-only until audit confirms issue)

- **Size**: SKIP immediate work. REFERENCE - audit child stdin writes for error listeners, audit SAP SDK for winston uncaughtException handler, implement fixes IF issue exists (MEDIUM ~6-8h).

#### 6. Kilocode CodeQL fixes REFERENCE-ONLY (CI)

- **What**: Kilocode PR #14905 (merged 2026-10-08) keeps CodeQL Kotlin job from OOM-killing runner. Commit title: "fix(ci): keep the CodeQL Kotlin job from OOM-killing the runner". CodeQL Kotlin workflow failed ~40% with "runner has received shutdown signal" (OOM). CodeQL sized itself for idle box (14575 of 16 GB RAM) while Gradle daemon (4 GB Xmx) and Kotlin compile daemon still resident; setup-gradle stops daemons in post step AFTER analysis. Fix: stop both daemons before analysis, cap CodeQL memory to leave headroom. Cleanup step dumps memory + top-RSS processes. Kilocode PR #14923 adds Promise.race syntax guard for CodeQL (no context in commit message).

- **Why**: Alexi has no Kotlin code (`src/` is TypeScript only). CodeQL workflows (if any) analyze TypeScript/JavaScript. Kilocode pattern: stop long-running daemons (Gradle, Kotlin compile, Node.js if applicable) before resource-intensive analysis steps, cap tool memory to leave runner headroom, dump diagnostics on failure. Alexi equivalent: audit `.github/workflows/` for CodeQL or static analysis jobs, check if jobs run memory-intensive steps (build, typecheck, lint) before/during analysis, stop daemons (e.g. `npm cache clean`, stop tsx/node processes) before analysis, tune memory caps. REFERENCE-ONLY: Alexi TypeScript codebase unlikely to hit OOM with CodeQL JavaScript analysis (smaller footprint than Kotlin). Monitor CI for OOM, apply pattern IF failures occur.

- **Source**: https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14905 (CodeQL OOM fix), https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14923 (Promise.race syntax), .github/workflows/ (CI jobs)
